Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with left arm numbness.
Chief_Complaint.source_text: I would say that, more of a problem for me, is that I can't quite move my left arm. I mean, I can move it but it's it's numb

Chief_Complaint.content: Patient reports tingling in the fingertips.
Chief_Complaint.source_text: and then I also feel some, like tingling in my fingertips.
Doctor: OK. Fine. So, you're definitely having some sort some form of weakness, OK. Patient: Yes, absolutely.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Left arm symptoms have been present for at least two weeks and are worsening.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: It's probably been, I'd say, for at least two weeks, and it's kind of gotten worse. Like,in the beginning, I just kind of felt a little bit of a tingling.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Numbness is felt in the elbow, arm, and hand.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Then the numbing kind of started I can feel it both in my, uh, um, you know a little bit in my elbow, and then in my arm, as well as in my hand

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Tingling affects the second, third, and fourth fingers of the affected hand.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: OK, so it's my second, third, and fourth finger.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Tingling is on the palmar (front) side of the hand.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No. It's, it's the, it's this side. So, the front side.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Sometimes experiences shoulder pain when moving during boxing.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: sometimes I will feel it in my shoulder. Like if I try to, if I try to like you know move like in boxing and stuff, I will even like, uh, um, maybe feel a little bit of, a little bit of pain.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Numbness and tingling are present at rest.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: if i'm just like resting if I'm sitting like, right now, I can feel like it's numb, and I, I actually feel, tingling right now, not in all of my fingers, just in some.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient notes difficulty with fine motor tasks, such as playing piano.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: well I play a little bit of a piano and so I just noticed it's been kind of harder to get the notes.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Denies neck pain.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Doctor: Edward, any neck pain at all? Patient: No, not, no, nothing .

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Symptoms are sensory (numbness) rather than pain-limited function.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No, no, it's not hurting, it's not hurting, it's, like, numb, I can't feel it, right? Well, yeah.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Tried massage and warm baths without improvement.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I tried to get a massage, it's not better. Or, you know, try to take warm baths. It's not better

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Has been taking a boxing class for a few weeks.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I've been taking this boxing class for a few weeks

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports right hand knuckle pain related to boxing.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: So, you know, I kind of hurt like my knuckles on my right hand. So that's been a little bit painful

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Experienced a transient loss of visual field in the left eye.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I all of a sudden just couldn't see from the, uh, from my left eye. Like, I, I lost some, like a little bit of a field of vision

History_of_Present_Illness.content: The visual disturbance lasted about 20 minutes.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: that, that just lasted not very long. I mean, that just lasted maybe for, I don't know, twenty, twenty minutes?

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Sometimes gets headaches described as tired headaches.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Um, sometimes I get headaches but I think they're just tired headaches.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports fatigue, including being too fatigued to go to the gym this morning.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: sometimes like this morning for example, I just felt really, fatigued and I couldn't even get myself to the gym.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Denies seizures or fits.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Doctor: Like when you you lose consciousness and you start shaking. Patient: Ohh, no, no, no, no, nothing like that, mmm mmm.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Legs and walking are normal; weakness limited to the left arm.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Doctor: And your weakness is only in your left arm. Legs are walking and all this, normal, yeah? Patient: Right, exactly. Patient: Yeah, yeah, yeah, walking is normal, yeah.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Does not wear glasses or contact lenses.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Doctor: Do you wear glasses at all, glasses, contact lenses? Patient: No.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports some jaw pain but it is not the main concern.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I mean it's part of the problem but I would say that, more of a problem for me, is that I can't quite move my left arm.

Past_Medical_History.content: Had a very bad cold about a month ago.
Past_Medical_History.source_text: I also had a really bad cold, like a month ago.

Past_Medical_History.content: Was ill for about two weeks with a flu-like illness.
Past_Medical_History.source_text: I was sick for probably good like two weeks. I was at home. I think I must have had some kind of like a flu or something.

Past_Medical_History.content: Denies any ongoing medical problems and considers herself generally healthy.
Past_Medical_History.source_text: in general, I'm, I'm pretty healthy. You know, I work out, uh, , and I, I don't really have any medical problems.

Medications.source_text: Not really. I just take ibuprofen every once in a while

Medications.content: Iron supplements were recommended by GP, but the patient often forgets to take them.
Medications.source_text: my my GP really wants me to take iron supplements, but you know, they're just like huge pills so I, I, most of the time I just forget.

Medications.content: Sometimes takes melatonin to help with sleep.
Medications.source_text: And then, sometimes I take Melatonin to help me sleep.

Family_History.source_text: I know that my dad has I don't know if it it's hypo, I think it's hypothyroidism.
he's got some autoimmune stuff going on, like that much I know.
my mom, my mom, she's actually not in a great shape. She's got diabetes type two.
she's got, gosh, what is it, ohh, yeah, she's got high cholesterol

Social_and_Family_History.content: Participates in a boxing class for several weeks.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: I've been taking this boxing class for a few weeks
I can, I can grasp, I can grasp a a glass but because I use my right hand most of the time, you know, I'm not left handed
well I play a little bit of a piano

Social_and_Family_History.content: Recently engaged in heavy alcohol use during a celebration, becoming uncharacteristically drunk.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: We kinda went crazy and we were like out partying until, you know, late hours, and I just got uncharacteristically drunk for me.

Assessment.content: Clinician is concerned the symptoms are more than a boxing injury.
Assessment.source_text: I'm just wondering whether there's something a bit more than just the boxing here.

Assessment.content: Multiple sclerosis is considered in the differential diagnosis.
Assessment.source_text: sometimes you know you do get things like MS, multiple sclerosis.

Assessment.content: MS considered due to visual problems and numbness/tingling.
Assessment.source_text: people with multiple sclerosis can have, um, visual problems, like what you've experienced and sometimes you know the odd numbness tingling sensations going on.

Plan_of_Care.source_text: I'm going to do an urgent, very urgent neurology referral. Yeah?

Plan_of_Care.content: Planned investigations may include a brain scan.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: What they, what that might entail is the brain scan and things like that.

Plan_of_Care.content: No treatment started now; steroids may be used during acute episodes but diagnosis must be confirmed first.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: No, that's something we can't do. The treatment for it is actually some steroids and things like that, uh, when you have an acute you know, acute reaction or things like that. But, saying that, first we need to firm diagnosis.

Follow_up_Information.content: Seek emergency care if weakness spreads to legs, or if headaches, vomiting, seizures, or worsening visual symptoms occur.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: if there's any weakness, uh, you know, if the weakness progresses to your legs, or there's any kind of headaches, vomiting, fits, and your visual symptoms are getting worse and not getting better, then that would be an A and E.
